program_solutions:
(rule!
  (let* ((sep-row (first (filter (lambda (r) (all? (lambda (c) (= (at g r c) 9)) (range 0 (cols g)))) (range 0 (rows g)))))
         (sep-col (first (filter (lambda (c) (all? (lambda (r) (= (at g r c) 9)) (range 0 (rows g)))) (range 0 (cols g))))))
    (foldl (lambda (p out)
             (let* ((r (first p)) (c (second p))
                    (mr (- (* 2 sep-row) r))
                    (mc (- (* 2 sep-col) c))
                    (targets (list (list r mc) (list mr c) (list mr mc))))
               (foldl (lambda (q acc)
                        (if (and (pos-in-bounds? q (rows g) (cols g))
                                 (not (= (first q) sep-row))
                                 (not (= (second q) sep-col)))
                            (set-cell acc (first q) (second q) 8)
                            acc))
                      out targets)))
           g (find-color g 1))))
